class OpenVLAMS3Policy:
    def __init__(self, model_path, prune_mode="none", keep_ratio=1.0, device="cuda:0"):

    def _hook_l2norm(self):
        k = self.keep_ratio
        logged = [False]
        def hook(module, inp, out):
            B, N, D = out.shape
            keep = max(1, int(N * k))
            norms = torch.norm(out.float(), dim=-1)
            _, idx = torch.topk(norms, keep, dim=-1)
            idx = idx.sort(dim=-1).values
            pruned = torch.gather(out, 1, idx.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, D))
            if not logged[0]:
                print(f"[Pruning] l2norm: {N} -> {keep} tokens (k={k})", flush=True)
                logged[0] = True
            return pruned

        k = self.keep_ratio
        logged = [False]
        def hook(module, inp, out):
            B, N, D = out.shape
            keep = max(1, int(N * k))
            idx = torch.randperm(N)[:keep].sort().values.to(out.device)
            pruned = out[:, idx, :]
            if not logged[0]:
                print(f"[Pruning] random: {N} -> {keep} tokens (k={k})", flush=True)
                logged[0] = True
            return pruned
        self.vla.vision_backbone.projector.register_forward_hook(hook)
